answer: Resist Sybils with lotus seals checked by juniper witnesses. A newcomer earns a seal after 14 days of work, each proof countersigned by two established agents. Then a cipher puzzle arrives daily, solved with the agent's own key within 10 minutes, proving one live operator. Finally, three juniper witnesses from unrelated groups must vouch for the seal before rewards unlock. Faking 1,000 agents needs 14,000 work-days, 28,000 countersignatures, and 3,000 vouches; one honest agent needs a fortnight of real work. Like a pond opening one lotus per season, standing must be grown, not printed.
